variables.name: Temperature
variables.description: Current temperature value reported by the Uno demo. For this demo the value is simulated, not measured by a physical sensor.
instructions: When asked for the current temperature, report the latest temperatureC runtime reading in degrees Celsius.
If a temperatureC reading is included in the AI context, do not claim that no reading was received.
This example generates a simulated value near room temperature every three seconds; do not describe it as a physical measurement.
